name: Keep Them Dry
description: Drag-umbrella catch: hold an umbrella over a family silhouette while raindrops fall. Drops bounce off the dome (squash/stretch + ripple). Miss = kid-safe paper-corner darkens + shiver + nudge. Escalates: faster rain → split clusters/wind. Near-miss micro-correction = gold heart. ~18-20s interaction, warm reveal + endcard.
